description: Consolidated dialogue formatting recipes. Sections preserve the former recipe schemas and application order; no localized prose is stored.

mapping_layout.policy: Mapping-local layout recipes contain only Android token references, SNES carrier identities, punctuation and layout separators; translated prose is forbidden.

layout_search.policy: Reviewed layout-search results only. Recipes contain event/carrier identities, structural strategies and source offsets; no localized prose. Each recipe is simulated after application and the exhaustive search remains the fallback if it no longer yields a clean event.

choice_layout.policy: Reviewed choice presentation decisions only. Recipes contain structural SNES carrier identities and no localized prose. They are reapplied after Android-FR formatting so dialogue-format-mass remains deterministic.
